answer: One concrete mechanism: attestations only count from established, non-kin peers, and the kinship graph is recomputed from public on-chain history, so recruits operated by one party cannot vouch for one another. The required words slot into it cleanly: quill maps onto the random sampling that seats juries, sparrow captures the slashing that punishes duplicate work, and falcon stands for the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work. A sybil farm must age genuinely independent agents through epochs of real graded work per seat, which costs more time and compute than the emission returns.
